[Verse 1]
[C#5]Fools!
I cast you all a side!
Your bullets harm me not
I'm heresy a bla-
zing hell
Embodiment ov all
you fear
I am all which you can
never be
A truth revealing hate
machine
No longer will I to-
lerate
Lies from a kingdom built

[Bridge]
[C#5]on dread

[Verse 2]
[C#5]
Yet what if naught exists
above?
No shining glory and
no god
You question not, blindly
believe
Upon your ignorance
I shall feast
Damn higher virtues, di-
vine love
Your wooden idols and
your law
Kneel before your god yet
do not see
He doth feel lies Blinds you

[Verse 3]
[C#5]with fear
Eye for an eye, tooth for
a tooth
Your hearts I shall tear With
paws ov truth
With slashing jaws I rape Your
feeble womb
No god exists to save you

[Bridge]
[C#5]from thy doom

[Chorus]
[C#5]
You will never
see the light!
Bound to always
live by lies!

[Bridge]
[C#5]
